title: Section 34 Arbitration Act — Set aside the award

content.overview: Section 34 is the only court recourse against a domestic award. It is not an appeal on facts.
content.study: Three months from receipt of the award, plus thirty days on sufficient cause, and no more. Public policy is patent illegality for domestic awards as enacted — not a second hearing. Stay of the award is section 36, not an automatic result of filing 34.
